n: Common Sense Education AI Literacy Lessons
t: Free short lessons that teach grades 6-12 what AI is and how it affects society.
steps: Find the AI Literacy Lessons for Grades 6-12 collection on the Common Sense Education site.
Choose a grade band and read the lesson titles.
Sign in for a free account if the site asks.
Download the slides and the student handouts for one lesson.
Print the handouts or plan to project them.
Run the lesson and use the dilemma questions to guide a short discussion.
